lines.japanese: 「ふう、クローズ作業の点検も終わりだ。もうクルーのみんなも帰ったようだな」
lines.english: “Whew, the closing inspection is finished. It seems the rest of the crew has gone home.”

lines.japanese: 「しかし……ちょっとした騒ぎもあったが、まあ、なんとかイブの忙しい一日を乗りきることが出来た。まったく、優秀な人材揃いで、俺は幸せな店長だな」
lines.english: “Still... There were a few disturbances, but somehow we made it through the Christmas Eve rush. I am blessed to manage such excellent people.”

lines.japanese: 「さて、俺もさっさと家に帰って休みたいところだが、明日に備えて少々残業していくとするか」
lines.english: “Now, I would like to hurry home and rest, but I suppose I should work a little overtime in preparation for tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、よいしょっと──」
lines.english: “Sigh. Heave-ho—”
“—whoa!”

lines.japanese: 「メリー！」
lines.english: “Merry!”

lines.japanese: 「クリス！」
lines.english: “Christ!”

lines.japanese: 「マース！」
lines.english: “Mas!”

lines.japanese: 「な、なな、なんだこれは……」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-what is this...?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、店長がびっくりしてる」
lines.english: “Ha-ha, we surprised the manager.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だって、おまえらもう帰ったんじゃ……しかも優まで……しかもその格好……」
lines.english: “But I thought you had all gone home... Even Yuu is here... And those outfits...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、着ていいって言ってたんで借りましたよ、先輩の秘蔵コレクション」
lines.english: “You said we could wear them, so we borrowed from your treasured collection.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえたち……俺のためにわざわざ……」
lines.english: “Y-you girls... You went to all this trouble for me...?”

lines.japanese: 「べっ、べつに店長のためとかじゃなくて、なんとなく……ノリだよ、ノリ」
lines.english: “D-don’t get the wrong idea! It wasn’t for you. We were just... going with the mood.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそ。べつに店長の青春話を聞いちゃったからとか、そういうわけじゃないよね」
lines.english: “Exactly. It had nothing to do with hearing that story about your youth.”

lines.japanese: 「そそそ。なんだかんだ世話ンなってるからとか、そんなん全然ないし」
lines.english: “Right. Or with how you’ve looked after us, when all is said and done. Nothing like that.”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、おまえたち……」
lines.english: “Y-you girls...”

lines.japanese: 「ば、ばっきゃろう、こんな粋な真似しやがって……目から、目から熱い汗が止まらないじゃねえか！」
lines.english: “Y-you idiots! Doing something this thoughtful... My eyes—my eyes won’t stop sweating!”

lines.japanese: 「先輩、そんな照れ隠しより、かわいい部下たちに言うことあるでしょ。私だって、このふたりからお願いされちゃって仕方なく戻ってきたんですからね」
lines.english: “Instead of trying to hide your embarrassment, don’t you have something to say to your adorable subordinates? I only came back because these two begged me.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうだったな。ありがとう、ふたりとも。つくづく俺は、店を持って良かった。最高のクリスマスプレゼントだ」
lines.english: “Quite right. Thank you, both of you. I am profoundly glad I opened this restaurant. This is the finest Christmas present I could have received.”

lines.japanese: 「へへー」
lines.english: “Heh-heh.”

lines.japanese: 「アッ！　これはつまり、第一回・制服乱交フェスティバル開催ってことだよね！」
lines.english: “Ah! In other words, this is the inaugural School-Uniform Orgy Festival!”

lines.japanese: 「あーあ……店長、本当シリアス話が苦手だよね」
lines.english: “There he goes... Manager, you really can’t handle a serious moment.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、私やっぱり帰ろうかな。こんな若い子のカッコまでして損した気分」
lines.english: “Sigh. Maybe I should go home after all. I feel cheated for dressing like such a young girl.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、すまんすまん。いや、自信を持て、優。おまえはその姿も似合ってるぞ」
lines.english: “Ha-ha! My apologies. Have confidence, Yuu. That outfit suits you.”

lines.japanese: 「え……や、ほんとですか？　私まだ現役でもイケます？」
lines.english: “Really? You mean it? I can still pass for a student?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、どこから見ても、立派に学園モノＡＶのようだ」
lines.english: “Indeed. From every angle, you look perfectly at home in school-themed porn.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあああああん！」
lines.english: “Waaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「日野君はいちばん若いだけあって、まったく違和感がないな」
lines.english: “Hino is the youngest, and so looks entirely natural.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、まーね。化粧の仕方なんかは多少変えたけど」
lines.english: “Well, yeah. I did adjust my makeup a little.”

lines.japanese: 「んふふー。みんなで制服選んだとき、えりちゃん真っ先にそれ選んだよねー？」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. When we picked out our uniforms, Eri went straight for that one.”

lines.japanese: 「ほほーう？」
lines.english: “Oh-ho?”

lines.japanese: 「な、なに。なんか問題あんの」
lines.english: “Wh-what? Is there a problem?”

lines.japanese: 「んふふー。ひよちゃんと同じの着てみたかったんでしょー」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. You wanted to wear the same uniform as Hiyo, didn’t you?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そういやコレ、あいつんトコの制服だっけ。ぜんぜん気にしてなかった」
lines.english: “Oh, right, this is her school’s uniform. I didn’t even think about it.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうむ、リボンも三色あったはずだが、わざわざ玉泉君と同じものを選んだのか。細かいな」
lines.english: “Hmm. There should have been three ribbon colors, yet you went out of your way to choose the same one as Tamaizumi. Such attention to detail.”

lines.japanese: 「ぐ、偶然だって！」
lines.english: “I-it was a coincidence!”

lines.japanese: 「んふふ？」
lines.english: “Hee-hee?”

lines.japanese: 「ぐふふ？」
lines.english: “Heh-heh?”

lines.japanese: 「って言う紀奈子ちゃんも、わりとあっさりその制服選んだよね。なんか理由あんの？」
lines.english: “Speaking of which, Kinako, you picked that uniform pretty quickly too. Any particular reason?”

lines.japanese: 「アオ女のブレザーは、前に一度着たことあるからね。次はセーラーの方を着てみたかったんさ」
lines.english: “I’ve worn the Azure Sky blazer before. This time, I wanted to try the sailor uniform.”

lines.japanese: 「しゃら～ん♪　どう、似合うー？」
lines.english: “Ta-daa♪ What do you think? Does it suit me?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、似合っていて可愛いぞ」
lines.english: “Yes, it suits you. You look adorable.”

lines.japanese: 「誰がポルノだ！」
lines.english: “Who are you calling porn?!”

lines.japanese: 「い、いえ、あの……ぼくいま普通に誉めましたけど……」
lines.english: “N-no, um... I was just giving you a compliment...”

lines.japanese: 「紀奈子さん、被害妄想強いっすね」
lines.english: “Kinako, you’re seriously paranoid.”

lines.japanese: 「まあいい、とにかく今夜はパァーっと行くか！　おお、そうだ、俺もあとで学生時代のボンタンを穿いてくるとしよう」
lines.english: “Never mind! Let us celebrate in grand style tonight! Oh, yes, perhaps I shall put on the baggy uniform pants from my own student days.”

lines.japanese: 「題して！　クリスマスだよアレキサンダー！　第一回チキチキ制服フェスティボォォォー！」
lines.english: “Christmas at Alexander! The First-Ever School-Uniform Festivaaaaal!”
“Yaaaay!”

lines.japanese: 「良かった、みんなまだいた。お疲れさ──」
lines.english: “Good, everyone’s still here. Thank you for your hard—”
“—work...”

lines.japanese: 「ひよちゃん！　間に合った、いま始まるとこだよ。千歳君はー？」
lines.english: “Hiyo! You made it just in time. We’re about to start. Where’s Chitose?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、差し入れ買っていくってコンビニ寄ってますけど……いえ、あの、皆さんなんでそんな格好……」
lines.english: “He stopped at the convenience store to buy something for the party... More importantly, why is everyone dressed like that...?”

lines.japanese: 「制服パーティーなんだって。玉木ちゃんも早く着替えてきなよ」
lines.english: “It’s a uniform party. Hurry and change too, Tamaki.”

lines.japanese: 「や、やですよ！　だいたい私、休みの日に制服なんて持ちあるいてません！」
lines.english: “N-no! I don’t carry my uniform around on my days off!”

lines.japanese: 「それなら心配無用。俺のコレクションから好きなものを選びたまえ。私立ぬるぬる学園のムフフなコスチュームもあるよ？」
lines.english: “Then you have nothing to fear. Select anything you like from my collection. I even possess a titillating costume from the prestigious Private Slippery Academy.”

lines.japanese: 「絶対いやです！」
lines.english: “Absolutely not!”

lines.japanese: 「相ッ変わらず固いなあ。おまえが反対しても、たぶん千歳はのっかってくるぞ」
lines.english: “Uptight as ever. Even if you object, Chitose will probably join in.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ねえねえ、千歳君だったら学ラン似合いそうじゃない？」
lines.english: “Oh! Don’t you think Chitose would look good in a stand-collar school uniform?”

lines.japanese: 「…………まあ、いいかも」
lines.english: “...That might be nice.”

lines.japanese: 「ようし、決まりー！　今夜はみんなで朝まで騒ぐぞ！」
lines.english: “Then it’s settled! Tonight, we party until morning!”

lines.japanese: 「イエーッ！　アレキサンダー、イエーッ！」
lines.english: “Yeah! Alexander, yeah!”
“Yeeeah!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、でも店長は、たしかラウンドガール的な女性と御予定があるんですよね」
lines.english: “Oh, but Manager, didn’t you have plans with a ring-girl-like woman?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「行ってらっしゃい、お気を付けて」
lines.english: “Have a good time. Travel safely.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん……そう、だね……」
lines.english: “Uh, yes... Of course...”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさああい！　もう嘘つきませええーん！」
lines.english: “I’m sooorry! I’ll never lie agaaain!”
